name: What are interior finish upgrades?
description: Interior finish upgrades improve the aesthetic and functional elements inside your home, such as flooring, paint, cabinetry, and fixtures.

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior finish upgrades involve enhancing the aesthetic and functional elements inside your home. This can include updating materials like flooring, paint, trim, cabinetry, countertops, and fixtures. These upgrades can range from minor cosmetic changes to complete overhauls, aiming to improve your home's appearance, comfort, and value.
